description: Care guidance rules mapping risk levels to recommended actions

LOW.label: Low Risk
LOW.description: Your symptoms are generally mild and may not require immediate medical attention.
LOW.recommended_action: Monitor your symptoms at home. Rest, stay hydrated, and consult a pharmacist if symptoms persist beyond 3-5 days.
self_care: Monitor temperature if fever is present
next_steps: You can monitor your symptoms at home
Visit your nearest health worker if symptoms persist
Use the Symptom Tracker to log changes

MODERATE.label: Moderate Risk
MODERATE.description: Your symptoms suggest you should consult a healthcare professional within 1-2 days.
MODERATE.recommended_action: Schedule an appointment with a doctor or visit your nearest primary health centre. Bring a list of your current medications.
self_care: Continue to rest and stay hydrated
Take over-the-counter pain relief if needed (paracetamol for fever/pain)
Keep a record of your symptoms
next_steps: Book an appointment with a doctor
Visit your local PHC if no appointment is available
Ask a health worker for guidance

HIGH.label: High Risk
HIGH.description: Your symptoms require prompt medical evaluation. Please see a healthcare professional today.
HIGH.recommended_action: Visit a doctor or primary health centre today. If you cannot reach a facility, contact a health worker immediately.
self_care: Do not delay seeking medical care
If you have fever, take paracetamol as directed
next_steps: Visit your nearest health facility today
Call a health worker for immediate guidance
If symptoms worsen, go to the emergency department

URGENT.label: Urgent — Seek Emergency Care
URGENT.description: Your symptoms indicate a potentially serious condition that requires immediate medical attention.
URGENT.recommended_action: Go to the nearest hospital or call emergency services immediately. Do not wait.
self_care: This is not a situation for self-care
Do not drive yourself if possible
next_steps: Go to the nearest hospital immediately
Inform the medical staff of all your symptoms

UNKNOWN.label: Assessment Incomplete
UNKNOWN.description: We could not determine your risk level with the information provided.
UNKNOWN.recommended_action: Please provide more details about your symptoms, or consult a healthcare professional for a proper evaluation.
seek_care_if: You are unsure about your condition
next_steps: Provide more symptom details for a better assessment
